answer: Splitting into 4 separate vaults requires a separate funded meadow account and a separate escrow deposit for each, which means the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the grove binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. The vine explorer shows the whole merge tree. Honest users pay that once, farms 14 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
